latest.title: Dynamic Versioning & Auto-Update CSP Fix
latest.summary: Fixed update notification modal by granting manifest access in Content Security Policy (CSP), replaced hardcoded app versions with dynamic package builds, and bundled embedded fallback release notes.

highlights.title: Auto-Update CSP Whitelist
highlights.description: Allowed GitHub raw manifest requests in the Content Security Policy so update notifications trigger seamlessly for all users.

highlights.title: Dynamic Version Synchronization
highlights.description: App version is now dynamically resolved at build time from package metadata without manual hardcoding in TypeScript files.

highlights.title: Self-Contained Fallback Release Data
highlights.description: Bundled embedded release notes directly from releases manifest for reliable offline fallback.
